# Copilot Instructions

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the canonical project guidance and read it before changing files.

- Keep all repository content in English.
- Inspect local patterns and persisted schemas before editing.
- Make small, scoped changes and use the deterministic project tooling.
- Treat sibling application and platform repositories as read-only evidence sources.
- Never invent missing facts or promote unsupported model output.
- Never disclose secrets or inspect excluded sensitive, generated, vendor, or build paths.
- Run the relevant tests and summarize changed files, validation, and remaining gaps.
